hints.title: Exponential Range Bounding
hints.text: When array boundaries are unknown, expand an exploration window exponentially until bounding the candidate value.

hints.title: Two-Phase Binary Search
hints.text: Double the high pointer index (1, 2, 4, 8...) while reader.get(high) is less than target. Then execute standard binary search within [low, high].

hints.title: Bounding and Search Blueprint
hints.text: Set low = 0, high = 1. While reader.get(high) < target: low = high, high *= 2. Binary search: while low <= high: mid = (low + high) // 2, val = reader.get(mid). If val == target return mid. Else adjust bounds. Return -1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
# """
# This is ArrayReader's API interface.
# You should not implement it, or speculate about its implementation
# """
#class ArrayReader:
#    def get(self, index: int) -> int:

class Solution:
    def search(self, reader: 'ArrayReader', target: int) -> int:
        low, high = 0, 1
        while reader.get(high) < target:
            low = high
            high *= 2
        while low <= high:
            mid = (low + high) // 2
            val = reader.get(mid)
            if val == target:
                return mid
            elif val < target:
                low = mid + 1
            else:
                high = mid - 1
        return -1
```

variables: T: index position of target element
complexity.notes: Exponential doubling takes O(log T) steps; binary search inside window takes O(log T) steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning takes O(T) time and triggers excessive reader interface queries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space with minimal reader API evaluations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of exponential stride galloping to bound infinite or unknown length arrays.
